subtitle: See what God has been making of you
description:
Dayspring is a journal for practicing Christians that shows you, over time, what God has been making of you.

Write freely. Dayspring turns what you wrote into what you can see — weekly, monthly, and yearly reflections grounded in your own words, never invented. Over time it surfaces the shape of a life with God: the threads you keep carrying, the Scripture that has actually met you, the vocabulary of your own walk.

What Dayspring is not: a streak tracker, a spiritual scorecard, or a sermon generator. It never grades your faith. It reads your life back to you.

SUBSCRIPTION
Dayspring is offered as an auto-renewing subscription.
• Monthly: $7.99 per month
• Annual: $69.99 per year
Payment is charged to your Apple Account at confirmation. The subscription renews automatically unless you turn off auto-renew at least 24 hours before the period ends. Manage or cancel anytime in your Apple Account settings.
